coverage_rules: Shifts are Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri and Sat, each with an AM and a PM slot: 12 shifts, written Day-Slot (for example Mon-AM).
Every shift has at least 2 volunteers.
Every shift has at least 1 volunteer whose role is lead.
A volunteer works only shifts listed in their available column.
No volunteer works more shifts in the week than their max_shifts.
No volunteer works both the AM and the PM shift on the same day.

brief.text: We are a small food pantry (a synthetic example). Each week our volunteers tell us when they can come in. Please build us a small kit that turns our volunteer availability CSV into a weekly shift schedule that meets our coverage rules, with tests and a README, so our own agent or staff can run it. Use only the synthetic data provided.
